note: P3866 (Pro 8:23) — ages ago I was set up, at the first, before the beginning of the earth.

dims.v: primordiality — Wisdom set up from everlasting
Wisdom's establishment from eternity, before the earth began
(the beginning of the earth she precedes)
the from-everlasting origin that grounds Wisdom's authority

olam (eternity/ancient time) — 'from OLAM I was set up (nasak)'; Wisdom's primordial, pre-cosmic establishment. Her from-everlasting origin is the ground of her supreme worth — she antedates all creation. Read as the eternality of Wisdom.
